reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount with the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already encodes the missing/number/worst-case-range rule.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the field is a one-line call to the shared helper.

placement.why: Added in scheduleModel.toExternal and APIScheduleEntity in api-models.ts, where the API shapes its schedule output.

scope.why: Just the field, its type, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Any future change to the expected-amount rule flows to the API automatically through the shared helper.
